## Copilot review overview ### 🔵 Needs a closer look The PR-controlled write workflow and BOM-related encoding-guard bypass must be resolved. **Review effort:** Balanced **Findings:** None
Resolved since last review (1) - VS discovery may select instance without v145
Previously missed (2) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Removing UTF-8 policy breaks language catalog validation `.editorconfig:57` This override removes the repository UTF-8 policy from language catalogs.
UTF-8 BOM bypasses copyright header validation `.github/scripts/check_source_encoding_lib.py:255` A UTF-8 BOM prevents the first copyright line from matching startswith.
